title: Object permanence is knowing a hidden thing is still there
summary: OpenStax defines object permanence as the understanding that something still exists when it is out of sight.
body: OpenStax Psychology, reporting Piaget, says object permanence is the understanding that even if something is out of sight, it still exists. The phrase names that understanding. It is not a stopwatch result and not a medical cutoff. The page sets the idea inside a theory of how thinking develops.

sources.title: OpenStax Psychology, 9.2 Lifespan Theories
